```plato
//==
// # Points
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Cartesian and homogeneous points
//  - Curvilinear coordinates
//  - Parametric coordinates

//==
// # Cartesian and homogeneous points
//
// Points are positions in a space (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_(geometry));
// they are not vectors. Subtracting two points yields a vector, and adding a
// vector to a point yields a point (the IDifference interface). This section holds
// the Cartesian positions and their homogeneous (projective) form; the
// curvilinear systems and the parametric weightings follow below.

// A position in the 2D Cartesian plane
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cartesian_coordinate_system).
type Point2D
    implements ICoordinate, IOriginBased<Vector2D>, IHashable, IMetricSpace, ITransformable2D
{
    X: Number;
    Y: Number;
}
```
